description: Rules for building the CSF question banks (/build-csf-bank). extract_cset_candidates.py flags each CSET question; build_question_bank.py routes each question per sector: rejected, accepted, or pending for the question bank judge agent.

truncated.description: A CSET question is flagged truncated (sent to the agent to be rewritten) if its text ends with one of these characters or is shorter than min_chars.

sector_by_model.description: CSET question sets that belong to one sector: their questions are accepted for that sector without an agent. Every other set is generic, and the agent decides which sectors its questions suit.

fanout_threshold.description: A question linked to this many CSF subcategories or more gets the agent's fit check for each one (build_question_bank.py --fanout-threshold overrides it).
